findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed that the chemical dish machine is not sanitizing to effective concentrations of Chlorine (currently measuring at 0ppm), as measured from the interior top of the dish machine. Observed that the chemical sanitizer bottle was registering a non-zero concentration of Chlorine, so PIC will work with maintenance staff to fix the chemical dish machine; the chemical dish machine will be removed from service until it is fixed. CORRECTED: Staff will use the triple sink to sanitize dishes (mostly water bottles) using approved bleach (Cl) which is unscented and NOT “low splash”. Ensure that the chemical sanitizer bleach (Chlorine) is used per manufacturer’s instructions to reach a safe and effective level of sanitizer, 50-200ppm for Chlorine.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed there was not a CFPM present for today’s inspection. Ensure there is always a CFPM present during operational hours.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Observed there were not signed employee health reporting forms at the facility. The PIC was provided with copies of the forms and present employees signed the forms. Ensure that signed employee health forms are always kept at the facility. 

2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the handwashing sink in the kitchen did not have handwashing soap. The employees were using a different sink in the dining area for handwashing. The PIC has been instructed to use the handwashing sink in the kitchen. The hand-sink in the kitchen was supplied with hand soap during the inspection. Ensure that all hand sinks are always supplied with hand soap. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed that shelving filled with bowls, cups, utensils, and other service items were observed to have an accumulation of dust and soil. The PIC stated that these service items were no longer being used. Inspectors advised that these items should be cleaned and stored in a back storage area. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed a leak underneath the wash portion of the triple sink. Ensure that plumbing systems are maintained in good repair. There will be a follow-up on 07/15/2024 to ensure the leak has been repaired. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed dishwasher to be improperly sanitizing. Observed food contact surfaces to be soiled with food debris. Corrected. Cl- Sanitizer was replaced. PIC stated containers will be cleaned.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment:
Dishwasher does not meet proper sanitation concentration. Chemical dishwashing must reach proper concentration to ensure food equipment is properly cleaned. Repair dishwasher. 
750-830 All chemical sanitizers in a dish machine must meet the requirements of 21 CFR 178.1010 to ensure all items are properly sanitized.  Rinse water shall not less than 75F. Provide proper sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment: 750-1280 Observed personal articles including cups, bags, and glasses stored on the shelving units storing food. Personal articles shall be stored in designated areas away from food or food contacts surfaces. Facility shall provide adequate personal article storage for employees. Personal articles were removed during the inspection to correct the violation.
